# Gate optional-module getters on the build feature that packages them

Put defineESModuleGetters for optional packaged modules under their feature flag. Packages without MOZ_UPDATER lack UpdateListener.sys.mjs. Only guarding a later call leaves an unavailable module exposed. Commit 275 moved the getter definition under AppConstants.MOZ_UPDATER, and current general.js retains it. Check builds with the feature disabled when changing these imports. This is a scoped packaging contract, not a claim about all lazy imports.

Scope: preferences updater.

Paths:

- `mail/components/preferences/general.js`
